fix_subject: Honor the record-batch validity bitmap in the v2 Arrow importer
pr_title: The Arrow C Data Interface lets the top-level struct array of a record

labels.summary: The v2 Arrow C Data Interface importer ignored the top-level struct's validity bitmap, so rows the record batch marked null were returned as non-null; the fix applies that bitmap to every column and rejects arrays with a positive null_count but no bitmap.
